## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 6 sept 2026 - 6 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Ryan Shook_, 6 sept 2026, 2/5: "I honestly really like FitAI and use it every day, but this billing issue is frustrating. I paid $108.11 for a yearly plan in 2024. In 2025, FitAI offered me a ~$30 yearly promo, which I accepted. I later discovered my original plan had also renewed for $108.11, leaving me with two overlapping yearly subscriptions on the same Google account. I never intended to pay for two annual plans at once. I’ve contacted support and hope they resolve it."
<!--/ir-theme-->
